messages:
Priya: Rapid sync  we must finalize priorities for the Optimize toolkit onboarding next sprint: batching heuristics, prefix caching, quant recs, eval-triggered alerts. Short answers pls.

Emma: I'll own batching + cache perf. Need p99 latency SLO target and three cost bands (15/30/50%).

Oliver: SRE risks: cache eviction storms, batch coalescing that spikes memory, hot-shard IO. Recommend staged canary + rate caps and auto-fallback.

Jason: Ops asks: pilot enrollment flow, feature flags per-customer, telemetry schema, and alpha/beta tiering.

Miguel: Customers want a simple slider (latency vs cost) and per-route quant suggestions. AcmeHealth volunteered for alpha.

Priya: Draft acceptance criteria: batching -> >=15% cost reduction on pilot w/o p99 > SLO; cache -> >=99% correctness on cached prefixes, TTL/invalidation controls; quant recs -> <=3% perf degradation or opt-out; eval alerts -> configurable thresholds, sample export, slack/email delivery.

Emma: I'll attach benchmark table + example config: optimize:
  batching:
    mode: prefix-aware
    max_batch_ms: 10
    max_size: 512
  cache:
    enabled: true
    ttl_secs: 3600
  quant_recommendation:
    strategy: per-route
    safety_threshold: 0.03

Oliver: Add infra requirements: rollback hooks, automatic fallback to FP model, trace sampling for cache misses.

LegalBot: Telemetry note: storing sample-level prompts requires contract addendum (+5 biz days).

Jason: Scheduling internal review Thurs 11:00am. Need Legal sign-off before telemetry goes live.

Priya: Timeline: spec PR by Tue, alpha invite list by Fri, pilot rollout across 2 sprints. Owners: @Emma perf artifacts, @Oliver runbook, @Jason pilot flow/legal, @Miguel customer confirmation.

Miguel: I'll confirm AcmeHealth traffic by EOD Friday.

Priya: Thanks all  will post matrix doc after PR. :rocket:
